title.en: Supportive clinical staff with corporate critiques

text.en: Long-term clients praise attending veterinarians, including Dr. Meleleo, for empathetic guidance and attentiveness during difficult medical decisions and end-of-life care. However, dissatisfied reviewers argue that practice culture has grown transactional, claiming that staff interactions sometimes emphasize financial billing over compassionate patient relationships.

title.en: Routine surgical recovery alongside diagnostic disputes

text.en: Several pet owners report positive outcomes following surgical procedures and praise attentive post-operative check-ins. On the other hand, multiple reviewers question clinical decisions, citing delayed identification of ear infections that required costlier interventions and recommendations for invasive procedures where conservative care was preferred.

title.en: Persistent client concerns over high fees

text.en: Pricing and billing policies receive sharp criticism across multiple client reviews. Pet owners report steep charges for routine ear treatments, costly add-on estimates such as multi-thousand-dollar dental cleanings, and perceived pressure to pursue invasive procedures rather than conservative medical management.

q.en: How does the hospital handle post-surgical care?

a.en: Pet owners report thorough follow-up after surgery, noting that clinic staff call to check on recovery progress and answer ongoing care questions.

q.en: Does the clinic accommodate large dog breeds?

a.en: Yes, multiple long-term clients mention bringing large breed dogs for routine wellness, preventative care, and specialized treatment.

q.en: Are detailed estimates provided before treatment?

a.en: While staff discuss treatment plans, several clients advise reviewing estimates carefully, as add-on diagnostic and dental recommendations can significantly increase the total bill.
